_doc: Canonical PurePep design tokens. Machine-readable mirror of colors_and_type.css. Edit BOTH or run scripts/sync-tokens.js (forthcoming) to regenerate one from the other. Consumed by: tailwind.config.ts (Next.js storefront), purepep-child/inc/tokens.php (WP child theme via hand-mirrored constants), brand previews, design system tools.

ink.role: Primary type, borders, primary CTA. Default text color.

ink-muted.role: Captions, eyebrows, micro-copy, disabled hint text.

bone-soft.role: Hover / subtle fill on bone surfaces.

surface.role: Secondary section bands, value-prop strips, alternating rows.

blush.role: Hero / testimonial band — ONE band per page max. Never on type.

line.role: Hairline for very subtle dividers only. Never load-bearing.

white.role: Reserved for type on ink surfaces. Never a page background.

emerald.role: Positive / in-stock / verified / COA pass. Type + 1.5px border, never hero fill.

emerald-soft.role: Optional 8% tint for emerald pill background.

alert.role: Negative / out-of-stock / destructive / error. Type + 1.5px border, never hero fill.

alert-soft.role: Optional tint for alert pill background.

amber.role: FAVICON ONLY. Never in UI, type, buttons, or merchandise. Hard restriction.

mono.stack: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

blur._doc: Backdrop blur is permitted ONLY on the sticky header backdrop and modal scrims. Never on cards, buttons, or other UI.

compliance.research-use-only: For research use only. Not for human consumption.
compliance.qualified-21: Sales restricted to qualified researchers, 21 and over.
compliance.no-refunds: All sales final. No refunds, no exchanges, no returns.
compliance._doc: Quote verbatim. Never paraphrase. Render on every product surface, in cart, checkout, and policy pages.

constraints._doc: These are off at the framework level (Tailwind corePlugins disabled, theme.json restricted). Re-enabling requires a brand-team decision.
